text: The pipeline begins with the input User Sequence alongside the Environment context.
These inputs feed into the Causal-Invariant Preference Encoder to perform Invariant Representation Learning.
This encoding process is supervised by the Invariant Risk Minimization loss.
Meanwhile, the Causal-Guided RAG Retriever accesses an Evidence Pool containing history, attributes, and knowledge graph data.
The learned invariant representation and the evidence pool are combined in the Debiased Retrieval step to score candidate evidence.
This retrieval yields the Top-K Evidence set.
In the Ranker and Explainer block, a Transformer Layer integrates the invariant representations with the retrieved evidence.
The transformer produces two outputs: a Recommendation Score and an Explanation text.
Finally, the outputs are evaluated using a Recommendation Loss and a Consistency Constraint connecting the explanation with the retrieved evidence.
